\pagestyle{empty}
\newcount\FHcalls
\newcount\FHentries
\newwrite\FHwrites
\immediate\openout\FHwrites=\jobname.nodes
\makeatletter
\def\FHstate{\the\parfillskip|\the\parskip|\the\parindent|\the\baselineskip|\the\lineskip|\the\lineskiplimit|\the\topskip|\f@encoding|\f@family|\f@series|\f@shape|\f@size|\f@baselineskip|\baselinestretch|\fontname\font}
\def\FHsave{\edef\FHsaved{\FHstate}}
\def\FHcheck{\edef\FHnow{\FHstate}\ifx\FHnow\FHsaved\else\errmessage{Outer font or paragraph state leaked}\fi\typeout{FH-RESTORED \FHnow}}
\let\FHrender\dte@render@tree
\def\dte@render@tree{\typeout{FH-FRAME \the\parfillskip|\f@family|\f@series|\f@shape|\f@size|\the\baselineskip}\FHrender}
\let\FHformat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{\global\advance\FHentries by1\write\FHwrites{ENTRY #1}\typeout{FH-ROW #1|\the\parfillskip|\f@series|\f@shape|\f@size|\the\baselineskip}\FHformat{#1}}
\makeatother
\AddToHook{shipout/before}{\ifnum\value{page}>24 \errmessage{No pagination progress}\fi}
\AtEndDocument{\typeout{FH-CALLS \the\FHcalls}\typeout{FH-ENTRIES \the\FHentries}}
